hints.tr: `elif` zinciri yukarıdan aşağı ilk tutan koşulda durur. Bu yüzden yalnızca üst sınırları yazman yeter: `if weight <= 2:`, `elif weight <= 5:`, `elif weight <= 10:`, `else:`.
hints.en: An `elif` chain stops at the first condition that holds, top to bottom. So writing only the upper limits is enough: `if weight <= 2:`, `elif weight <= 5:`, `elif weight <= 10:`, `else:`.

hints.tr: İndirim ayrı bir `if`: `if is_member and cost >= 50:` ve içinde `cost = cost * 0.8` (%20 indirim = fiyatın %80'i).
hints.en: The discount is a separate `if`: `if is_member and cost >= 50:` with `cost = cost * 0.8` inside (20% off = 80% of the price).
